On 10 March 2014 Giltay delivered the manuscript of The Cover-up General in person at the Ministry of Defence for the Minister’s attention, against a signed receipt, asking for a response within two weeks.
🇳🇱 [Giltay to the Minister of the Interior, 18 March 2014](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/minBZK-aanbieding.htm) Letter
Edwin Giltay delivered the manuscript of The Cover-up General to the Minister of the Interior before publication and asked for a response, which could still be included in the book if it arrived within two weeks.
🇳🇱 [Jan Pronk to Giltay, 31 July 2014](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/pronk.htm) Email
Four months before The Cover-up General appeared, former Minister Jan Pronk agreed by email to the wording of his endorsement: ‘meticulously written and well documented’.
🇳🇱 [Christ Klep to Giltay about his quote, 17 August 2014](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/klep.htm) Email
The August 2014 email thread in which military historian Christ Klep likens the manuscript of De doofpotgeneraal to the spy classic Our Man in Havana.
🇳🇱 [Marco Gerritsen to Giltay, 24 November 2014](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/aanmelding.htm) Email
Reply from Marco Gerritsen, counsel for the Mothers of Srebrenica, to the invitation to the book launch: the ‘failure’ of the film roll ‘has always been implausible to us’, he writes, and he registers a colleague to attend.
🇳🇱 [Leidsch Dagblad on the book launch, 27 November 2014](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/leidschdagblad.htm) Article
An excerpt from the Leidsch Dagblad of 27 November 2014, in which investigative journalist Brenno de Winter, who accepted the first copy, says it is important that the film roll riddle be solved for good.
🇳🇱 [EenVandaag, item on De doofpotgeneraal and the film roll, 5 December 2014](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/eenvandaag.htm) Article
EenVandaag, the news and current affairs programme of the Dutch public broadcaster AVROTROS, on the missing Srebrenica film roll and the book The Cover-up General, 5 December 2014.
🇳🇱 [Lenneke Sprik on Twitter, 26 December 2014](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/sprik.htm) Tweet
The tweet of 26 December 2014 in which Lenneke Sprik says she is reading The Cover-up General with bated breath and that it feels like fiction.
2015
🇳🇱 [Barbara Overduyn, LinkedIn profile, 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/linkedin.htm) Profile
Barbara Overduyn’s own LinkedIn profile, listing her as an assistant at the intelligence department of the MIVD, Defence, from May 1995 to December 1998.
🇳🇱 [Barbara Overduyn’s writ of summons against Giltay, 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/dagvaarding.htm) Writ
In her 2015 writ of summons, Barbara Overduyn states that the Ministry of Defence was already aware of The Cover-up General but had decided to take no action against it.
🇳🇱 [Catalogue entry of the NIOD Library, 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/niod.htm) Catalogue entry
The library catalogue of the NIOD Institute for War, Holocaust and Genocide Studies in Amsterdam returns one result for De doofpotgeneraal, the printed 2014 edition.
🇳🇱 [Nieuwe Revu, four-star review, 4 February 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/revu.htm) Review
The four-star review of De doofpotgeneraal in the Dutch weekly Nieuwe Revu, 4 February 2015, one of the glowing reviews that preceded the ban on the book.
🇳🇱 [Ministry of the Interior to Giltay, 5 February 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/nietreageren.htm) Letter
In February 2015 the Ministry of the Interior told Edwin Giltay that the Minister had taken note of the manuscript of De doofpotgeneraal and would not respond to it substantively.
🇳🇱 [Bram van Ojik to Giltay, email, 12 February 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/ojik.htm) Email
Email from Bram van Ojik, leader of the GroenLinks group in the House of Representatives, to Edwin Giltay, 12 February 2015, on the need for robust external oversight of the intelligence and security services.
🇳🇱 [Endorsement by the lawyers for the Mothers of Srebrenica, 17 February 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/gerritsen.htm) Email
The February 2015 email in which the lawyers for the Mothers of Srebrenica send a quote endorsing De doofpotgeneraal, for use in the promotion of the book.
🇳🇱 [Ministry of the Interior to Giltay, 2 March 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/minBZK-1.htm) Letter
On 2 March 2015 the Ministry of the Interior confirmed receipt of Edwin Giltay’s supplementary complaint about the AIVD and reported that it had been forwarded to the CTIVD.
🇳🇱 [Checkpoint, review, April 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/checkpoint.htm) Review
In April 2015 the veterans’ monthly Checkpoint reviewed De doofpotgeneraal, saying it reads like a thrilling and highly detailed roman à clef, and raffled five copies among its readers.
🇳🇱 [NBD Biblion review of the first edition, 10 April 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/biblion2015.htm) Review
The NBD Biblion review of De doofpotgeneraal, 10 April 2015, a recommendation from the review service of the Dutch libraries. The review was part of the critical acclaim that preceded the ban.
🇳🇱 [Ministry of the Interior to Giltay, 17 April 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/minBZK-2.htm) Letter
A 2015 ministerial letter that declares one part of a complaint about the AIVD unfounded and refuses to consider the other part, on the affair described in the book, because it is too old.
🇳🇱 [Roel van Duijn to Giltay, 8 May 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/vanduijn.htm) Email
The email of 8 May 2015 in which the politician Roel van Duijn sent Edwin Giltay the one-sentence recommendation that the Voices section carries.
🇳🇱 [Haarlems Weekblad, review, 27 May 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/haarlemsweekblad.htm) Review
The Haarlems Weekblad review of De doofpotgeneraal, 27 May 2015. The piece appeared after Edwin Giltay was a guest at the Pletterij debate café in Haarlem.
🇳🇱 [Mothers of Srebrenica, statement of appeal, 7 July 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/memorie-grieven.htm) Court filing
In their 2015 appeal against the Dutch State, the Mothers of Srebrenica cite The Cover-up General for the claim that the film roll had not failed and that the photos are being withheld.
🇳🇱 [Thrillerlezersblog on the demand for a ban, 6 August 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/thrillerlezers.htm) Post
A Dutch thriller blog reports the demand that De doofpotgeneraal be withdrawn from sale, and finds that a fuss is being made about a book while what happened around the roll of film has still not been explained.
🇳🇱 [Leidsch Dagblad, report on the damages claim, 21 November 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/schadevergoeding.htm) Article
The Leidsch Dagblad report of 21 November 2015 on a claim by a former employee of the Military Intelligence Service for compensation and a rectification over the book The Cover-up General.
🇳🇱 [District Court of The Hague, judgment of 14 December 2015 (ECLI:NL:RBDHA:2015:15050)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/ecli-nl-rbdha-2015-15050.htm) Judgment
In 2015 the District Court of The Hague banned The Cover-up General outright and forbade its author to promote the book at lectures, book presentations and other public utterances.
🇳🇱 [District Court of The Hague, judgment of 14 December 2015, unofficial English translation](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/censuurvonnis-vertaald.htm) Judgment
In December 2015 the District Court of The Hague banned The Cover-up General outright, prohibiting distribution, reprinting and even promotion of the book at lectures, book presentations and other public utterances, on pain of a penalty payment of up to 100,000 euros. This is the unofficial English translation.
🇳🇱 [Harry van Bommel, Member of Parliament, on Twitter, 21 December 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/onderpand.htm) Tweet
Harry van Bommel, Member of Parliament, replies on Twitter, a week after the total ban, that De doofpotgeneraal may be lent only against serious collateral, because it has become priceless.
🇬🇧 [Index on Censorship, alert, 24 December 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/indexoncensorship.htm) Record
On 24 December 2015 the press-freedom platform Mapping Media Freedom logged the Dutch court ban on De doofpotgeneraal as a verified violation.
🇷🇸 [Radio-televizija Srbije on the Dutch ban, 24 December 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/rts.htm) Article
The Radio-televizija Srbije report of 24 December 2015 on the Dutch ban, sketching the two factions within the Ministry of Defence over the Srebrenica film roll.
🇷🇸 [Vesti, Serbian news site, on the ban, 24 December 2015](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/vesti.htm) Article
Ten days after the Dutch court ban, the Serbian news site Vesti reported it under the headline ‘Marijuana is permitted there, but a book about Srebrenica is not’.
2016
🇳🇱 [NJF 2016/242, the appeal judgment in the De doofpotgeneraal case in a case-law journal](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/njf-2016-242.htm) Legal journal
The case-law journal Nederlandse Jurisprudentie Feitenrechtspraak published the appeal judgment of 12 April 2016 as NJF 2016/242; the case-law site jure.nl lists this publication among the places where the judgment is published.
🇳🇱 [RAV 2016/75, the appeal judgment in the De doofpotgeneraal case in a legal journal](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/rav-2016-75.htm) Legal journal
The legal journal Rechtspraak Aansprakelijkheid en Verzekering published the appeal judgment of 12 April 2016 as RAV 2016/75, under a heading that names the book.
🇳🇱 [NBD Biblion review of the revised second edition, 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/biblion.htm) Review
The NBD Biblion review of the revised second edition of De doofpotgeneraal, in which the review service for Dutch libraries records that the book had even been banned for a time.
🇧🇦 [Caspar ten Dam in Dnevni Avaz, 4 January 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/avaz2015.htm) Article
The Dnevni Avaz article of 4 January 2016 in which Caspar ten Dam says Giltay will appeal and, if need be, take the book ban to the European Court.
🇳🇱 [Giltay’s appeal writ against Barbara Overduyn, 8 January 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/appeldagvaarding.htm) Writ
The 2016 appeal writ in which Giltay’s lawyers call the blanket ban on his book censorship and warn of its chilling effect on other authors.
🇳🇱 [Overduyn’s statement of defence to the Court of Appeal of The Hague, 2 February 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/memorie.htm) Court filing
The statement of defence filed for Barbara Overduyn on appeal on 2 February 2016, which does not challenge that Giltay has refuted her dismissal claim in writing with evidence.
🇳🇱 [Blog post quoting Eric van de Beek, 11 February 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/vandebeek.htm) Post
A Dutch blog post on the banning of De doofpotgeneraal, quoting journalist Eric van de Beek, who attended the hearing and says the former MID employee produced no evidence.
🇳🇱 [Radio interview with Giltay before the appeal hearing, NOS Radio 1, 25 February 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/interview.htm) Audio
A radio interview with Edwin Giltay on NOS Radio 1, broadcast on the morning of 25 February 2016, minutes before the Court of Appeal of The Hague heard the appeal against the ban on his book.
🇳🇱 [TPTV, clip from the appeal hearing, 25 February 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/hofzitting.htm) Video
A 13-second clip from the TPTV report ‘Het verboden boek’ (The forbidden book), in which Giltay’s lawyer Jurian van Groenendaal tells the Court of Appeal of The Hague that banning an entire book practically never happens in a democratic society.
🇳🇱 [Schrijven Online, report on the appeal hearing, 26 February 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/schrijven-zitting.htm) Article
Schrijven Online, the trade platform for Dutch authors, reported from the appeal hearing on the ban on De doofpotgeneraal: 30 exhibits on Giltay’s side against one.
🇳🇱 [Court of Appeal of The Hague, judgment of 12 April 2016 (ECLI:NL:GHDHA:2016:870)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/ecli-nl-ghdha-2016-870.htm) Judgment
In 2016 the Court of Appeal of The Hague lifted the ban on The Cover-up General and held that the two undisputed inaccuracies were insufficient to cast doubt on the author’s meticulousness.
🇳🇱 [Court of Appeal of The Hague, judgment of 12 April 2016, unofficial English translation](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/arrest-vertaald.htm) Judgment
Unofficial English translation of the 2016 Court of Appeal judgment that lifted the ban on The Cover-up General (De doofpotgeneraal) and ruled that at least part of the book concerns matters that can be the subject of a debate of public interest.
🇳🇱 [Hebban, Court of Appeal overturns book ban, 12 April 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/hebban2016.htm) Article
Hebban reports that the Court of Appeal of The Hague has overturned the ban on De doofpotgeneraal, with a comment from Giltay’s lawyer Jurian van Groenendaal.
🇳🇱 [Historian Maarten van Rossem on Facebook, 12 April 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/vanrossem.htm) Post
Facebook post by the historian Maarten van Rossem, 12 April 2016, reporting that the Court of Appeal of The Hague had lifted the ban on The Cover-up General that same day, with the comments beneath it on page 2.
🇧🇦 [Novi.ba on the censorship being lifted, 12 April 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/novi-ba.htm) Article
The Bosnian news portal Novi.ba reported on the evening of 12 April 2016 that the Court of Appeal of The Hague had lifted the ban on the book, and quoted Colonel (retd) Charlef Brantz.
🇳🇱 [Schrijven Online, book ban lifted on appeal, 12 April 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/schrijven2016.htm) Article
Schrijven Online, the trade platform for Dutch authors, reports that the Court of Appeal of The Hague has overturned the ban on De doofpotgeneraal, and quotes Giltay and his counsel.
🇳🇱 [Harry van Bommel, blog post, 15 April 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/parlementaire-monitor.htm) Post
Days after the Court of Appeal of The Hague quashed the ban, MP Harry van Bommel welcomed the ruling on his weblog and recommended The Cover-up General to everyone.
🇳🇱 [Vincent van der Kraan, comment, 16 April 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/vanderkraan.htm) Blog comment
An editor who read the manuscript of De doofpotgeneraal writes that it made his hair stand on end and that he warned Edwin Giltay to watch out for repercussions.
🇮🇹 [31 Mag interviews Giltay, 12 July 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/31mag.htm) Article
On 12 July 2016 the Dutch Italian-language weblog 31 Mag published an interview with Edwin Giltay about the missing Srebrenica film roll, the ban on his book and the judgment in which the Court of Appeal of The Hague lifted that ban.
🇳🇱 [Presentation of the second, revised edition to Philip Dröge, 16 September 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/droge.htm) Video
A 16-second clip from the video of the book launch on 16 September 2016, in which Edwin Giltay handed the first copy of the revised edition of De doofpotgeneraal to Philip Dröge.
🇳🇱 [Salto TV item on the presentation of the second, revised edition, 16 September 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/salto-tv.htm) Video
An eight-minute Salto TV item on the presentation of the second, revised edition of De doofpotgeneraal on 16 September 2016, with various speeches, including one by freedom-of-information specialist Roger Vleugels.
🇳🇱 [Dick van der Veen, five-star review, Hebban, 23 September 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/hebban-vanderveen.htm) Review
The five-star reader review of De doofpotgeneraal by Dick van der Veen, published on the reader community Hebban on 23 September 2016.
🇳🇱 [De Volkskrant, books column, 22 October 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/volkskrant2016.htm) Article
In a column of short book notices, de Volkskrant ties The Cover-up General to the failed roll of film from Srebrenica and reports that the ban has been quashed on appeal.
🇳🇱 [Willem Middelkoop on Twitter, 23 October 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/middelkoop.htm) Tweet
The post of 23 October 2016 in which author and journalist Willem Middelkoop shares a photograph of a page of the book and calls reality stranger than the wildest conspiracy theory.
🇳🇱 [ANP report on eight rolls of film, 28 November 2016](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/achtrolletjes.htm) Article
ANP report of 28 November 2016: lawyers for more than two hundred Dutchbat III veterans seek a court order for access to prints of at least eight rolls of film in the MIVD archive.
2017
🇳🇱 [Boekje Pienter, five-star review, 2017](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/boekje-pienter.htm) Review
The 2017 five-star review of De doofpotgeneraal on Boekje Pienter, a Dutch military reading guide, in which the reviewer calls the book almost suffocating to read.
🇳🇱 [LeesKost review, 30 January 2017](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/leeskost.htm) Review
Job ter Steege reviews the second edition of De doofpotgeneraal for LeesKost and finds high-ranking officials pilloried by their own bungling.
🇳🇱 [National Ombudsman on the Giltay file, 18 May 2017](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/kluis.htm) Note
An internal 2017 note in which a staff member at the National Ombudsman records that Giltay’s complaint file is a secret file kept in the safe because the military intelligence service was involved.
🇳🇱 [Ministry of Defence to Giltay, 6 June 2017](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/buirma.htm) Letter
In June 2017 the Ministry of Defence refused to retract the 1999 declaration of insanity, saying Giltay’s letter offered no new facts and that his case was closed.
🇳🇱 [Court of Appeal of The Hague, judgment of 27 June 2017 (ECLI:NL:GHDHA:2017:1761)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/ecli-nl-ghdha-2017-1761.htm) Judgment
In 2017 the Court of Appeal of The Hague held the State liable for 30 per cent of the damage, ruling that Dutchbat had denied some 350 men on the compound a chance of escaping execution.
🇳🇱 [Speaker Khadija Arib to Giltay, 27 June 2017](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/arib.htm) Letter
In June 2017 the Speaker of the Dutch House of Representatives replied to Giltay that she could not respond to the substance of his case, and forwarded his letter to the Standing Committee on Defence.
🇧🇦 [Dnevni Avaz interview with Giltay, 11 July 2017](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/dnevniavaz2017.htm) Article
The Dnevni Avaz interview of 11 July 2017, published on the day of the commemoration, in which Giltay says that Srebrenica still haunts the Netherlands.
🇳🇱 [De Blauwe Tijger press release, 12 September 2017](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/persbericht.htm) Press release
On 12 September 2017 publisher De Blauwe Tijger announced that the Standing Committee on Defence of the House of Representatives would take up Edwin Giltay’s case, and quoted F-16 pilot Victor van Wulfen on psychiatrisation.
🇳🇱 [Hart van Nederland, item with MP Sadet Karabulut, 14 September 2017](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/karabulut.htm) Video
A 17-second clip from the Hart van Nederland news item of 14 September 2017, in which MP Sadet Karabulut says the Minister of Defence must answer Edwin Giltay.
🇳🇱 [Standing Committee on Defence to Giltay, 18 September 2017](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/commissie.htm) Letter
In September 2017 the Standing Committee on Defence of the Dutch House of Representatives decided to ask the Minister of Defence for a response to Giltay’s letter about the Srebrenica cover-up.
🇺🇳 [Giltay to the ICTY Office of the Prosecutor, 24 September 2017](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/icty2017vraag.htm) Email
Giltay’s email of 24 September 2017 asking the ICTY prosecutor whether the prosecution had ever demanded access to the rolls of film said to be held in military intelligence archives.
🇺🇳 [ICTY Office of the Prosecutor to Giltay, 3 October 2017](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/icty2017.htm) Email
The ICTY Office of the Prosecutor tells Edwin Giltay it has no knowledge of the eight rolls of film said to be held in Dutch military intelligence archives.
🇳🇱 [Letter to Parliament from Minister of Defence Dijkhoff to Speaker Arib, 13 October 2017](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/kamerbrief.htm) Letter
The 2017 letter in which the Minister of Defence answers the House of Representatives about Giltay’s book, reporting the NIOD verdict that the film-roll theory is improbable.
🇳🇱 [Director of the MIVD to Giltay about a CTIVD report, 24 October 2017](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/bijlage19.htm) Letter
In October 2017 the Director of the MIVD wrote to Giltay that the CTIVD had handled no complaint of his against the service and that there was therefore no CTIVD report.
2018
🇳🇱 [Frank de Grave and Jan Tromp, Grote jongen zijn, 13 February 2018](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/degrave.htm) Autobiography
In his 2018 memoir Grote jongen zijn, former Defence Minister Frank de Grave looks back on his decision not to dismiss Secretary-General Dirk Barth, who signed Giltay’s declaration of insanity on his behalf.
🇳🇱 [Giltay to the National Ombudsman, 13 March 2018](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/verzoekschrift.htm) Letter
Letter of 13 March 2018 in which Edwin Giltay puts to the National Ombudsman nine grievances against the Ombudsman himself and two new complaints about Defence, backed by a dossier of 19 exhibits.
🇽🇧 [Burco Online News, Banned Books, 22 March 2018](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/burco.htm) Article
The Burco Online News article of 22 March 2018 that calls for banned books to be collected and burned or destroyed, and lists The Cover-up General among banned books worldwide.
🇳🇱 [Jan Born on Twitter, 28 March 2018](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/born.htm) Tweet
Investigative journalist Jan Born argues on Twitter for an external, independent review of all internal Defence inquiries, and writes that no proper investigation was done in the cases of whistleblowers such as Edwin Giltay.
🇳🇱 [Reading tip from the Dutchbat III Association, 28 March 2018](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/dutchbat.htm) Search results
A PDF print of Google search results of 28 March 2018 in which the Facebook page of the Dutchbat III veterans association recommends the banned and later released book as a reading tip.
🇳🇱 [National Ombudsman to Giltay, with Giltay’s letter of 13 March 2018, 10 April 2018](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/ombudsman.htm) Letter
In 2018 the National Ombudsman refused to reconsider his 1999 report on Giltay’s complaint and closed the correspondence, saying further letters would merely be noted and filed without reply.
🇧🇦 [Naša Bosna on the meeting with Ambassador Čolaković, 17 April 2018](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/ambassade.htm) Article
A Naša Bosna report on the working visit to the embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in The Hague, where Ambassador Mirsada Čolaković expressed the wish for a Bosnian translation of the initially banned book De doofpotgeneraal.
🇧🇦 [Al Jazeera Balkans interview, 21 July 2018](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/aljazeera-fotos-2018.htm) Interview
Al Jazeera Balkans interviews Edwin Giltay about the Srebrenica photographs the Dutch military intelligence service tried to conceal, and about the subsequent ban on his book.
🇧🇦 [Slobodna Bosna, interview with Giltay on the withheld photographs, 21 July 2018](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/slobodnabosna.htm) Article
The Slobodna Bosna article of 21 July 2018, in which the Bosnian news site describes the photographs of nine bodies near Srebrenica and publishes an interview with Giltay about the ban on his book, naming Al Jazeera as its source.
🇳🇱 [Novini, Defensie flatert voort, 25 August 2018](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/novini.htm) Article
The Novini article of 25 August 2018 in which Minister of Defence Ank Bijleveld says that fact and fiction do indeed become intertwined in the book.
🇳🇱 [Forum of EthnoGeoPolitics, on the failings of the Ministry of Defence, Summer 2018](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/ethnogeopolitics.htm) Article
The English version of the guest column by Jeroen Stam, in which Dutchbat veteran Remko de Bruijne says Defence keeps everything under wraps to avert damages claims.
🇮🇩 [Koran SINDO on banned books, 15 October 2018](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/koran-sindo.htm) Article
An Indonesian daily lists The Cover-up General among the banned books of the 21st century, noting the Dutch court ban and its reversal in 2016.
🇳🇱 [Minister Bijleveld to Giltay on Twitter, 25 October 2018](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/twitter.htm) Tweet
Reply by Minister of Defence Ank Bijleveld to Edwin Giltay on Twitter, 25 October 2018, telling him he is completely right on a point of military terminology.
2019
🇷🇺 [Book Wagon on VKontakte, 13 February 2019](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/bookwagon.htm) Post
A Russian book community on VKontakte lists The Cover-up General among the books banned in the 21st century, noting the Dutch court ban and its reversal in 2016.
🇳🇱 [Supreme Court of the Netherlands, judgment of 19 July 2019 (ECLI:NL:HR:2019:1223)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/ecli-nl-hr-2019-1223.htm) Judgment
In 2019 the Supreme Court of the Netherlands limited the liability of the State for the men sent away from the Dutchbat compound on 13 July 1995 to ten per cent of the damage suffered by their surviving relatives.
2020
🇳🇱 [De Andere Krant, book page, 6 May 2020](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/dak.htm) Article
In May 2020 the Dutch newspaper De Andere Krant reviewed De doofpotgeneraal in its books section, noting that the Court of Appeal had thrown out an earlier ban on the book.
🇳🇱 [Giltay to the Ministry of Defence, 29 June 2020](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/viermaal.htm) Letter
In June 2020 Giltay delivered four letters in person to the Ministry of Defence, again inviting a substantive response to his book, this time with a German edition in view.
🇳🇱 [Charlef Brantz, Srebrenica: De Schuldigen, passage on the film roll, 10 July 2020](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/brantz.htm) Book
In his 2020 book Srebrenica: De Schuldigen, Colonel (retd) Charlef Brantz, in July 1995 acting commander of the UN sector under which Dutchbat fell, writes that as early as August 1995 he voiced his doubts on the Dutch current affairs programme NOVA about the army’s explanation for the loss of Rutten’s film roll.
🇳🇱 [Ministry of Defence declines to respond substantively to the book, 29 July 2020](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/geenbehoefte.htm) Letter
The letter in which the Ministry of Defence tells Giltay, on 29 July 2020, that Defence has no need to respond substantively to his book.
2021
🇳🇱 [Minister of Justice and Security to Giltay, 12 January 2021](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/justitie.htm) Letter
In 2021 the Minister of Justice and Security told Edwin Giltay, in answer to his question whether his book fell under anti-government propaganda, fake news or conspiracy theories, that the classifications in Terrorist Threat Assessment Netherlands 53 were in no way based on his book The Cover-up General.
🇳🇱 [Onafhankelijke Defensiebond, book review, 10 May 2021](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/defensiebond.htm) Review
On 10 May 2021 the Dutch military trade union Onafhankelijke Defensiebond ran a book review of De doofpotgeneraal, which opens with the news that the banned book could appear again.
🇳🇱 [Roelie Post on Twitter, 10 August 2021](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/roeliepost.htm) Tweet
The post of 10 August 2021 in which European Commission whistleblower Roelie Post tells the author she is reading his book and that it opens up a world for her too.
2022
🇧🇦 [Balkan Insight on the 2.6 million euros the State spent, 21 January 2022](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/balkaninsight.htm) Article
Balkan Insight reports that the Dutch State paid 2.6 million euros to its state attorney to fight the Srebrenica liability cases, figures released after a request by journalist Edwin Giltay.
🇳🇱 [Giltay to the Minister of Defence, with the third, revised edition, 26 April 2022](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/mist.htm) Letter
Giltay delivered the third, revised edition of De doofpotgeneraal in person for the attention of the Minister of Defence, Kajsa Ollongren, on 26 April 2022, with a covering letter about the mistakes of her predecessors.
2023
🇧🇦 [Catalogue entry of the Srebrenica memorial centre, 11 January 2023](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/potocari.htm) Catalogue entry
The COBISS Plus catalogue lists one copy of the Dutch 2016 edition of De doofpotgeneraal at the library of the Srebrenica Genocide Memorial, and marks it as not for loan.
🇳🇱 [Constitution, Article 45 on the coherence of government policy, text of 14 March 2023](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/grondwet.htm) Constitution
Article 45 of the Dutch Constitution, in the text published in the Staatsblad (Bulletin of Acts and Decrees) by Royal Decree of 14 March 2023: the Ministers together constitute the Cabinet, which considers and decides upon overall government policy and promotes the coherence of that policy.
🇳🇱 [District Court of The Hague, judgment of 18 July 2023 (ECLI:NL:RBDHA:2023:17841)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/ecli-nl-rbdha-2023-17841.htm) Judgment
In 2023 the District Court of The Hague quashed the National Ombudsman’s refusal to consider Giltay’s Woo request for government documents and ordered the institution to decide on it after all.
🇳🇱 [District Court of The Hague, judgment of 27 December 2023 (ECLI:NL:RBDHA:2023:20409)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/ecli-nl-rbdha-2023-20409.htm) Judgment
The District Court of The Hague ordered the National Ombudsman to decide within two weeks on a freedom-of-information request, on pain of a penalty payment of 100 euros for every day of delay.
2024
🇸🇷 [Dagblad Suriname on censorship, 13 February 2024](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/suriname2024.htm) Commentary
The Dagblad Suriname editorial of 13 February 2024 that cites the overturned ban on The Cover-up General as an example of censorship in a democracy.
🇳🇱 [ING bank statement, penalty payment by the National Ombudsman, 16 February 2024](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/bankafschrift.htm) Bank statement
ING statement of 16 February 2024 showing the National Ombudsman transferring €1,900 to Giltay, described on the transfer as a penalty payment for the late Woo decision in case SGR 23/6997.
🇳🇱 [Karin Vaalburg, National Ombudsman, to Giltay, emails, 8 January to 21 February 2024](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/vaalburg.htm) Email
The 2024 email thread in which the National Ombudsman’s senior legal adviser praises the book’s documentation and then forgoes a planned meeting about Giltay’s file for the time being.
🇳🇱 [National Ombudsman to Giltay, 28 February 2024](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/weigering.htm) Email
The National Ombudsman tells Edwin Giltay that a staff member has checked the sum, that the count remains at nineteen days, and that Giltay has received the correct penalty payment.
🇳🇱 [District Court of Rotterdam, judgment of 6 March 2024 (ECLI:NL:RBROT:2024:1770)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/ecli-nl-rbrot-2024-1770.htm) Judgment
In preliminary relief proceedings brought in 2024 by President Chan Santokhi of Suriname against a book about corruption in government circles, the District Court of Rotterdam cited the 2016 appeal judgment in the De doofpotgeneraal case and rejected his claims.
🇪🇪 [Video of the launch at the Banned Books Museum, Tallinn, 7 April 2024](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/bannedbooks.htm) Video
Video of the Tallinn launch of the free English edition of The Cover-up General, in which the Banned Books Museum calls the book a very rare example of an author who successfully challenged a book ban.
🇿🇦 [Gerard Scharn on The Cover-up General in Versindaba, 5 August 2024](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/versindaba.htm) Article
On the South African literary weblog Versindaba, the writer Gerard Scharn recommends The Cover-up General as a book that takes the reader from one astonishment to the next.
🇳🇱 [Personal record of Barbara Overduyn, official spelling of her name](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/persoonslijst.htm) Record
An extract from the Dutch population register giving Barbara Overduyn’s name in its official spelling. The book took the spelling Overduin from the MID investigation; she herself signed as Overduijn in 1999. She died on 19 November 2024.
🇪🇺 [Anders Vistisen MEP to Giltay, 10 December 2024](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/vistisen.htm) Email
The Danish MEP Anders Vistisen tells Edwin Giltay that his group has decided not to support Reinier van Zutphen as a candidate for European Ombudsman.
🇪🇺 [Ton Diepeveen MEP to Giltay, 10 December 2024](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/diepeveen.htm) Email
The email in which Dutch MEP Ton Diepeveen tells Edwin Giltay that everyone knows De doofpotgeneraal and that he read the book in one sitting.
🇪🇺 [Office of Axel Voss MEP to Giltay, 11 December 2024](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/voss.htm) Email
The reply of 11 December 2024 in which the office of German MEP Axel Voss tells Giltay that Voss knows of the concerns about the Dutch candidate and will weigh them in his vote.
2025
🇶🇦 [Al Jazeera Documentary photo story on Instagram, 22 April 2025](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/aljazeera-instagram-2025-04.htm) Post
The ten-slide Arabic photo story in which Al Jazeera Documentary tells its audience the story of The Cover-up General, the Dutch book banned in 2015.
🇺🇸 [Mohamed Alsiadi on Instagram, 22 April 2025](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/alsiadi.htm) Post
The comment in which Prof. Mohamed Alsiadi of Rutgers University calls the book an important basis for documenting the genocide in Bosnia, under an Al Jazeera post of 22 April 2025.
🇧🇦 [Giltay to Ćamil Duraković, 27 May 2025](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/durakovic.htm) Email
Giltay puts the quotation about De doofpotgeneraal to Duraković himself, word for word and with the circumstances of the meeting, and asks whether he has any objection to its use.
🇧🇦 [Hasan Nuhanović to Giltay, 27 June 2025](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/nuhanovic.htm) Email
The email of 27 June 2025 in which Hasan Nuhanović, survivor of the Srebrenica genocide, gives Giltay written permission to quote his words of congratulation on the book.
🇺🇸 [Andrew Hales to Giltay, 1 July 2025](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/study.htm) Email
Andrew Hales of the University of Mississippi thanks Edwin Giltay for taking part in the censorship study, which has grown into a broader research project.
🇳🇱 [Militaire Spectator, three Defence historians call for a new debate, 5 July 2025](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/spectator2025.htm) Article
Three Dutch Defence historians argue that Srebrenica went wrong not because of the UN mandate itself but because of the narrow reading given to it, and that the lesson is more relevant today than ever.
🇶🇦 [Al Jazeera Documentary photo story on Facebook, 11 July 2025](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/aljazeera-facebook-2025-07.htm) Post
The Al Jazeera Documentary photo story of 11 July 2025, which told its Arabic-speaking audience the story of the Dutch book on Srebrenica that had been banned ten years earlier.
🇶🇦 [Al Jazeera Documentary photo story reposted on Instagram, 11 July 2025](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/aljazeera-instagram-2025-07.htm) Post
The Al Jazeera Documentary photo story on the Dutch book banned in 2015, posted again on Instagram on 11 July 2025, thirty years after the fall of Srebrenica.
🇮🇱 [The Fearless Berdichever: essay for the beit din, 12 August 2025](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/berditsjever.htm) Essay
An essay by Edwin Giltay on Rebbe Levi Yitzchak of Berdichev, presented to the rabbinical court in 2025, in which Giltay also describes his role as a witness to a Dutch cover-up surrounding Srebrenica.
🇺🇸 [Grok (xAI) endorses The Cover-up General on X, 4 November 2025](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/grok-aanbeveling.htm) Post
Post in which Grok, the chatbot of Elon Musk’s company xAI, publicly endorses The Cover-up General on X and calls the reversal of the book ban a victory against censorship.
🇺🇸 [Grok on X calls its endorsement, to its knowledge, xAI’s first public book recommendation, 6 November 2025](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/grok-scoop.htm) Post
The post of 6 November 2025 in which Grok, answering a direct question from the author, states that, to its knowledge, xAI had never before publicly endorsed a specific book on X.
🇮🇱 [Beit din certificate of conversion to Judaism, 20 November 2025](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/certificate.htm) Record
A rabbinical court sitting in Delft declares that Edwin F. Giltay was recognised as a full member of the people Israel on 20 November 2025 and received the name Eliyahu.
2026
🇳🇱 [Reading list of the Week van het Verboden Boek, 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/tiplijst.htm) Reading list
The reading list of Week van het Verboden Boek 2026, which names De doofpotgeneraal, banned in the Netherlands in 2015 and 2016 to protect the good name of a person in the book.
🇳🇱 [Defence libraries catalogue entries, 23 March 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/biebs2.htm) Catalogue entry
Catalogue records of the Netherlands Ministry of Defence libraries, showing De doofpotgeneraal on the shelves at the KMA, the KIM and the NIMH.
🇳🇱 [Peace Palace Library catalogue entry, 23 March 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/vredespaleis.htm) Catalogue entry
The Peace Palace Library in The Hague holds De doofpotgeneraal in its closed stacks at shelfmark 500 G 13 and has catalogued it under war crimes, espionage and intelligence agencies.
🇺🇬 [Solomy Balungi Bossa at the debate in The Hague, 25 March 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/bossa.htm) Photograph
Photograph and announcement of the public debate at Amare, The Hague, on 25 March 2026, where Judge Solomy Balungi Bossa of the International Criminal Court was the guest.
🇺🇬 [Giltay to the International Criminal Court, 26 and 31 March 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/icc.htm) Email
Edwin Giltay twice asked the International Criminal Court to pass a message to Judge Solomy Balungi Bossa, inviting her to comment on a paragraph about her words at a public debate in The Hague. No reply had been received by 14 April 2026.
🇳🇱 [Royal Library catalogue entry, accessed 17 May 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/bibliotheek.htm) Catalogue entry
The Royal Library catalogue entry for De doofpotgeneraal, whose summary says a former Casema employee reveals espionage aimed at suppressing evidence of war crimes.
🇧🇦 [Giltay to Munira Subašić, 20 May 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/subasic.htm) Letter
A letter accompanying a printed copy of the English edition; in it Giltay reminds the president of the Mothers of Srebrenica of his meeting with her at the Palace of Justice on 27 June 2017.
🇳🇱 [National Ombudsman acknowledges the calculation error in the penalty payment, 11 June 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/fouterkenning.htm) Email
Email of 11 June 2026 in which the National Ombudsman accepts that it counted one day too few and paid 1,900 euros where 2,000 euros was due, and sets out the recalculation.
🇳🇱 [Supplementary penalty payment by the National Ombudsman, 26 June 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/nabetaling.htm) Bank statement
The ING bank statement recording the supplementary penalty payment of €100 by the National Ombudsman, credited on 26 June 2026, 28 months after the initial payment.
🇨🇭 [Zenodo record for the Dutch edition, deposited 1 July 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/zenodo-nederlands.htm) Catalogue entry
The Zenodo record at CERN in Geneva that holds the free Dutch e-book of De doofpotgeneraal, the third, revised edition, and gives it the permanent DOI (Digital Object Identifier) 10.5281/zenodo.21116205.
🇨🇭 [Zenodo record for the English edition, deposited 1 July 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/zenodo-engels.htm) Catalogue entry
The Zenodo record at CERN in Geneva that holds the free English e-book of The Cover-up General and gives it the permanent DOI (Digital Object Identifier) 10.5281/zenodo.21115325.
🇧🇦 [Catalogue entry in the National and University Library of Bosnia and Herzegovina, 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/nubbih.htm) Catalogue entry
The COBISS catalogue entry for The Cover-up General in the National and University Library of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Sarajevo, which holds one copy (COBISS-ID 69836038).
🇩🇪 [Entry in Die Kasseler Liste, 17 August 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/kasselerliste.htm) Record
The entry for De doofpotgeneraal in Die Kasseler Liste, a database of censored books, recording the Netherlands as country of ban, 2015 as year of ban and 2016 as year the ban was lifted.
🇬🇧 [Catalogue entry of the Wiener Holocaust Library, 23 September 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/wiener.htm) Catalogue entry
The Wiener Holocaust Library in London holds the English edition, The Cover-up General, has catalogued it under intelligence services, genocide and censorship, and lists its copy as available.
🇳🇱 [Publications about and mentions of The Cover-up General, 2014–2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/medialijst.htm) List
The author’s list of 415 publications about and mentions of De doofpotgeneraal / The Cover-up General from 2014 to 2026: 364 listed individually, with a link for each item still online or preserved in the Internet Archive.
🇩🇪 [Catalogue entry of the Leibniz Institute for East and Southeast European Studies, 2 October 2026](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/card/en/regensburg.htm) Catalogue entry
The Leibniz Institute for East and Southeast European Studies in Regensburg holds the English edition, The Cover-up General, and keeps it in its stacks under shelf mark W 01/2026.2300.

Mirror websites and continuity: [Primary](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl) | [GitHub](https://edwingiltay.github.io/thecoverupgeneral/) | [Web Archive](https://web.archive.org/web/20260000000000*/dedoofpotgeneraal.nl). Part of the author’s paper archive was lost in an arson attack in 2011; digital copies have been preserved at various locations. A connection with this affair is unlikely but cannot be ruled out: the perpetrator was never traced. The mirrors serve the continuity of this documentary work; the e-books are moreover permanently deposited at [CERN](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21115325). Wellbeing statement: The author is determined to continue his work and has no suicidal thoughts. This statement carries a date, is public and verifiable, and serves as a precaution, given the documented risks and the history of this affair.
